newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-LLANELLI TO APPEAL JONES'S BAN.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-LLANELLI TO APPEAL JONES'S BAN.

text.p: Welsh rugby union club Llanelli said on Monday they would appeal against a 60-day ban given to flanker Iuean Jones who was sent off during a European Cup match against French side Pau at the weekend.
It was the first time that Jones had been sent off in his playing career and Llanelli, who won the match 31-15, are hoping that video evidence will help his case. Jones was dismissed for fighting.
In a bad-tempered match three players were dismissed, with Pau flanker Nicolas Bacque being suspended for 30 days for punching while scrum-half Frederic Torossian was banned for 60 days for stamping.
